title: ジャパンカップの後に・伝えたい一言

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa thrills the audience with her victory against Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this race wasn't enough for Special Week. She's eager for a rematch with El Condor Pasa at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This now means that El Condor Pasa, Special Week, and Grass Wonder will all face off in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, the Arima Kinen has turned into a battle between three close friends and a much-anticipated race for the audience.
